duration.text: The Lawsuit Law at Southwest University for Nationalities is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2077 USD/per year ￥ 14960 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Master's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of postgraduate school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 3 or above 6. Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents. 7. List of academic/research productions Give in details, if any. 8. Study plan Including study purpose, research interest and research plan in brief.

requirements.text: Have the Master's Degree or equivalent, HSK 6 or above, obey Chinese laws, and without fatal health problems.
